[P2] Require retirement proof for omitted service attempts

A `COLLECTED` capture with otherwise valid evidence can add a journal request carrying `discoveredAtMs` and still return `PASSED`, even when that request has no execution binding or retirement evidence. This exemption is never reconciled against the complete retirement inventory: `_evaluate_capture` rejects omitted client launches but validates retirement projected onto the original resources. Consequently, offline replay can certify a run with unaccounted service work. Before granting this exemption, require each omitted service request to match a complete, validated retirement snapshot that proves its invocation and execution settled, and add a negative replay test for missing proof.
